fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Heading across the top of the card, e.g. "Media Resources".

fields.name: left
fields.label: Left card
fields.description: Left part of the card: a heading, text, and a list of contact links. List items linking to a phone number (tel:), an email (mailto:) or Twitter/X get their icon automatically.

fields.name: right
fields.label: Right card
fields.description: Right part of the card, e.g. "Additional information" with links.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Presentation
fields.description: Full width stretches the card across the whole content width (default: centred, 10 of 12 columns).
